notes.title: Improved Internal Timer Performance
notes.content: We've made improvements to the internal timer to reduce lag on low-end PCs. However, to maintain fairness, a validation system has been implemented. Attempting to tamper with your PC's internal clock will be considered cheating and reset the timer back to 6 hours. This may affect players in regions with automatic daylight saving time changes. We recommend avoiding playing during these times. Thank you for your patience, and we hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Menu adaptable to different screen resolutions
notes.content: Thanks to a user support we found out that there was an error when the game was running in a screen with a different screen size, so we fix it so it can adapt to wherever screen size you have (no sure about 800x600 though :s)
